title: 'Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2' Reveals New Staff, Teaser Promo for Fall 2026
content: • The official website of the Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2 ( Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 ) television anime revealed the new staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Monday. The anime series adapting Buncololi 's comedy fantasy light novel is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.
author: MyAnimeList

title: BLEACH Unveils Final "THE STORIES" Visual as Thousand-Year Blood War Retrospective Begins
content: The ongoing TV ANIMATION BLEACH THE STORIES retrospective project has officially entered the Thousand-Year Blood War arc, with a fifth and final special visual released ahead of the anime’s return later this year . You can see the new visual below.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sasaki and Peeps 2nd Season Anime Reveals October Debut, More Returning Staff in New Promo Video
content: Kadokawa revealed on Monday a new promotional video, new visual, additional returning staff members, and the October debut for the second season of the television anime of writer Buncololi and illustrator Kantoku 's Sasaki and Peeps ( Sasaki and Pichan ) novels.
author: ANN

title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 Reveals New Trailer and Visual, Different Director & Main Staff
content: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 has revealed a new key visual and trailer for the anime, along with confirming an October 2026 release date. Season 2 will feature some notable staff changes. Yushi Ibe has been appointed director, with Yamato Ochi serving as assistant director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Confirms October 2026 Premiere, Returning Director & Main Staff
content: Black Clover has confirmed that Ayataka Tanemura will return to direct the anime’s second season, reuniting the creative team behind both the original TV anime and the 2023 film Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King .
author: Anime Corner

title: Within the Villainess Reveals New Teaser Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast
content: The previously announced Within the Villainess revealed a new teaser visual and trailer mainly featuring the new cast member, Pina Blance (voiced by Ayane Sakura). Studio Roll2 is animating the series, set to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles Browser Game Launches
content: Online gaming platform G123 launched its The Apothecary Diaries Palace Chronicles browser game based on author Hyuganatsu and illustrator Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on Sunday. The company streamed a video for the release.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Anime Season 2 Unveils Director, October TV Debut
content: TV Tokyo announced on Monday that the second anime season based on Yūki Tabata 's Black Clover manga will premiere on TV Tokyo in October. TV Tokyo also announced that Ayataka Tanemura , the director of episodes 153-170 of the first Black Clover anime and the film Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King , will direct…
author: ANN

title: It’s Official, Black Clover Season 2 Just Set a Release for the Anime’s Return
content: It’s finally official as Black Clover ‘s anime has now confirmed it’s coming back with Season 2 of the anime this Fall after five long years. Black Clover has been the most anticipated anime return of the year as the first season of the series left fans on a major cliffhanger.
author: ComicBook

title: Within the Villainess Anime Casts Ayane Sakura as Star Maiden
content: Kadokawa presented a new "heroine" promotional video and another teaser visual for the television anime of author Makiburo and illustrator Mai Murasaki 's Within the Villainess ( Akuyaku Reijō no Naka no Hito ) light novel series and Nazuna Shiraume 's manga adaptation on Monday.
author: ANN
